pr.body:
## What does this PR do?

- Converts destinationCalendar on CalendarEvent to be an array.
- Patches and fixes so every sentence of code that was using evet.destinationCalendar can support the new type of array.
- The logic here is to fallback to normal behaviour has having one main destinationCalendar but also supports multiple so host can get invited correctly.

Fixes #7754 
## Loom 
Creating event and rescheduling:
https://www.loom.com/share/3cb3af513d274ed2bdfed44e48edddf6?sid=d81ce3de-2893-4a30-b085-ff67c31b7dfb

Canceling event:
https://www.loom.com/share/7ef505d4665e4d4982d2bb2d7b118085?sid=cd43c97c-aa86-4667-979f-f6492adf3365

## Requirement/Documentation

## Type of change

<!-- Please delete bullets that are not relevant. -->

- [X] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

## How should this be tested?

- Are there environment variables that should be set? No
- What are the minimal test data to have? Setup a collective event using teampro and teamfree users. Add any app calendar to those accounts and add them as host for collective event.
- What is expected (happy path) to have (input and output)? Collective event with 2 host and every user with any calendar app installed should receive proper calendar events.
- Any other important info that could help to test that PR

## Mandatory Tasks

- [X] Make sure you have self-reviewed the code. A decent size PR without self-review might be rejected.

## Checklist

- I haven't added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works

raw_findings.body: `evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` yields [], the destructured mainHostDestinationCalendar is undefined, and reading `.integration` throws a TypeError, aborting event creation.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Runtime TypeError on a common path (Google Meet without Google Calendar), crashing booking creation.
raw_findings.impact: `evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` yields [], the destructured mainHostDestinationCalendar is undefined, and reading `.integration` throws a TypeError, aborting event creation.
raw_findings.root_cause: Converting destinationCalendar to an array and destructuring the first element removed the optional-chaining guard that the previous `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration` provided.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Use optional chaining as before, e.g. `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.integration !== "google_calendar"`.
raw_findings.title: Null dereference on mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration when no destination calendar
raw_findings.trigger: A booking whose location is Google Meet (MeetLocationType) but whose CalendarEvent has an empty or null destinationCalendar (e.g. organizer and eventType both lack a destination calendar, so handleNewBooking sets it to null/[]).

raw_findings.body: The optional-chained push is a no-op, so teamDestinationCalendars are silently discarded and host calendar events are never created for those members—defeating the PR's purpose.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silent data loss: collective hosts without organizer destination calendar receive no calendar invites.
raw_findings.impact: The optional-chained push is a no-op, so teamDestinationCalendars are silently discarded and host calendar events are never created for those members—defeating the PR's purpose.
raw_findings.root_cause: The ternary at lines 1063-1067 falls back to `null`, making the subsequent optional-chained push skip appending team calendars.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Default destinationCalendar to an empty array instead of null (or initialize before pushing) so team destination calendars are always appended.
raw_findings.title: Collective team destination calendars dropped when organizer has no destination calendar
raw_findings.trigger: A COLLECTIVE event where neither eventType.destinationCalendar nor organizerUser.destinationCalendar is set (evt.destinationCalendar becomes null), but team members have destinationCalendars.

raw_findings.impact: The find compares each cal.externalId against the falsy externalCalendarId, so it never matches; selectedCalendar becomes undefined and is passed as calendarId to the Google update, causing the update to fail/target the wrong calendar.

raw_findings.suggested_fix: When externalCalendarId is falsy, fall back to the first/main destinationCalendar's externalId (e.g. `event.destinationCalendar?.[0]?.externalId`) rather than filtering by the falsy value.
raw_findings.title: updateEvent selectedCalendar fallback compares externalId against the falsy externalCalendarId
raw_findings.trigger: updateEvent invoked with a falsy externalCalendarId while relying on event.destinationCalendar to supply the target calendar.

raw_findings.impact: The find compares against the falsy externalCalendarId and never matches, so calendarId is undefined and the code silently deletes from the default "primary" calendar instead of the intended destination calendar.
raw_findings.root_cause: The array migration replaced `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` with a find keyed on the same falsy externalCalendarId used to guard the branch.

raw_findings.title: deleteEvent calendarId fallback compares externalId against the falsy externalCalendarId
raw_findings.trigger: deleteEvent invoked with a falsy externalCalendarId while relying on event.destinationCalendar to supply the target calendar.

raw_findings.body: Previously non-calendar references used `result.credentialId`; now they are forced to undefined, so video booking references are persisted without a credentialId, breaking later credential-specific lookups (e.g. cancellation of the video meeting).
raw_findings.failure_mode: Video reference stored without credentialId, causing downstream credential lookups to fail.
raw_findings.impact: Previously non-calendar references used `result.credentialId`; now they are forced to undefined, so video booking references are persisted without a credentialId, breaking later credential-specific lookups (e.g. cancellation of the video meeting).
raw_findings.root_cause: Refactor replaced the non-calendar branch value `result.credentialId` with `undefined` while switching to result-based externalId/credentialId.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the video credential: `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : result.credentialId` or `result.credentialId ?? undefined` as done in updateEvent.
raw_findings.title: Video (non-calendar) result loses credentialId in create() referencesToCreate
raw_findings.trigger: create() processing a non-calendar (video) EventResult that carries a credentialId.
